tax_litigation.status: The appeal was heard by the Hon'ble ITAT on 23 July 2026 and the ITAT issued its order dated 21 September 2026. The ITAT has accepted the transfer pricing method, its mechanism and approach adopted by the Company. Accordingly, majority of the adjustment has been deleted. On one ground, while accepting the approach of benchmarking adopted by the Company, the ITAT has restored the limited issue of computation of the arm’s length price following the approach adopted by the Company. The Company now awaits the order giving effect to the ITAT order to be issued by the assessing officer (majority of the demand shall stand deleted and where the verification of one ground which is low quantum, is also positive, then the entire demand would be deleted).
